newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal completes note offering.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal completes note offering.

text.p: Commercial Federal Corp said Monday it completed a public offering of $50 million of five-year subordinated extendible notes with a rate of 7.95 percent.
It said Piper Jaffray Inc, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Montgomery Securities underwrote the offering.
Proceeds will be used to refinance Commercial Federal's $40.3 million of 10.25 percent subordinated notes due 1999 and $6.9 million of 10.00 percent senior notes due 1999.
Commercial Federal is the parent of Commercial Federal Bank.
